basic_info.description: Thoughtfully renovated 1920s condo, designed as a sophisticated home in a meticulously maintained, Neoclassical elevator buildin. This remarkably spacious,  residence features inviting formal living & dining areas adorned with rich wood floors, fireplace, & expansive windows that frame sweeping views, bathing these rooms in an abundance of natural light. The kitchen showcases higher-end appliances, 2 ovens, and quartz countertops. 3 bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite complete with 2 walk-in closets. A versatile office area between the kitchen and dining room is a must-have amenity for those working from home. With a convenient laundry/utility room off of the kitchen and tons of closet and cabinet space throughout, this unit also includes a massive, secure storage room for effortless organization of sporting equipment, luggage and other bulky items. An independent parking space is located two doors away and has been used by two consecutive owners of unit #3 for nearly 3 decades. A rear garden provides spaces for residents to unwind. Steps to Lafayette Park, 2.5 blocks to shops on Fillmore St., and 5 blocks in either direction to Whole Foods or Mollie Stones, this elegant condo is also only a 6 blocks to Swan Oyster Depot!
